# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 16 tokens; Text — 5 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 20 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 34 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 14 tokens; Radius — 10 tokens; Shadow — 8 tokens; Blur — 2 tokens; Grid — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #081615 | #f4fbf7 | Page and conversation ground. Dark is the default theme. |
| `surface-dim` | #081615 | #d5dbd8 | Dimmed ground behind modal scrims. |
| `surface-bright` | #2e3c3a | #f4fbf7 | Brightest surface step; hover highlight on dense rows. |
| `surface-container-lowest` | #04100f | #ffffff | Sunken wells: code blocks, chart plots, field interiors. |
| `surface-container-low` | #111e1d | #eff6f2 | Sidebar rail and quiet side panels. |
| `surface-container` | #152221 | #e9f1ed | Default card fill. |
| `surface-container-high` | #1f2c2b | #e3ebe7 | Raised tiles inside cards (the 8px icon tile of a card header), hovered chrome. |
| `surface-container-highest` | #2a3736 | #dde6e2 | Highest ladder rung: floating menus, selected segmented tab. |
| `surface-variant` | #2a3736 | #dbe5e0 | Toolbar separators (1px bars 16–24px tall) and gauge tracks. |
| `surface-tint` | #00e29b | #006c48 | Material tint colour for tonal elevation overlays. |
| `background` | #081615 | #f4fbf7 | Document background; same as `surface`. |
| `surface-canvas` | #081615 | #f4fbf7 | Semantic alias — page ground. |
| `surface-sunken` | #04100f | #ffffff | Semantic alias — wells and code blocks. |
| `surface-card` | #152221 | #e9f1ed | Semantic alias — card fill. |
| `surface-raised` | #1f2c2b | #e3ebe7 | Semantic alias — raised tile in a card. |
| `surface-float` | #2a3736 | #dde6e2 | Semantic alias — floating menus. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--text-primary);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-primary` | #d6e6e3 | #171d1b | Semantic alias — body copy on any surface. Prefer the semantic names in product code. |
| `text-muted` | #b9cbbe | #3f4945 | Semantic alias — subtitles and metadata. |
| `text-accent` | #cfffe2 | #006c48 | Semantic alias — accented text, links, active nav labels. |
| `text-on-accent` | #006b48 | #003824 | Semantic alias — label on the neon fill. |
| `text-code` | #c8e9e4 | #00513f | Ink for code blocks and inline code on `surface-container-lowest` (14.9:1 dark, 9.3:1 light). |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--outline);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `outline` | #849589 | #6f7975 | Inactive glyphs and control borders. Text use on dark only (5.9:1 on `surface`); on light it is 4.3:1 — icons and borders there, not body text. |
| `outline-variant` | #3b4a41 | #bfc9c4 | Decorative dividers only; below 3:1 in both themes, so never the sole boundary of a control. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--brand-neon);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (34)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand-neon` | #00f5a9 | #00f5a9 | The brand accent, identical in both themes. Live status dots, the chart line, glows. As text only on the dark ground (12.9:1 on `surface`); on light grounds it is a fill, never ink (1.4:1). |
| `brand-teal` | #5fffd5 | #5fffd5 | Diffuse form of the accent: hover edges and hairlines at 8–25% alpha, the solid border of hovered glass. Never a fill. |
| `brand-obsidian` | #02221f | #02221f | Deep ink for the logo and marks knocked out of a neon field. |
| `brand-canvas` | #061312 | #061312 | The outermost canvas behind the dark app shell. |
| `brand-ivory` | #fffbf5 | #fffbf5 | Warm ivory reserved for prompt/input text and high-contrast inverse badges on dark (17.9:1 on `surface`). |
| `inverse-surface` | #d6e6e3 | #2b3230 | Inverse fill for high-contrast tooltips and snackbars. |
| `inverse-on-surface` | #263332 | #ecf2ef | Text on `inverse-surface`. |
| `primary` | #cfffe2 | #006c48 | Accented text and glyphs: the active nav label, links, the accent icon (16.8:1 dark, 6.2:1 light on `surface`). |
| `primary-container` | #00f5a9 | #00f5a9 | THE brand neon as a fill, theme-invariant: primary CTA, active states. At most two or three uses per view. |
| `inverse-primary` | #006c48 | #49ffb6 | Accent text on `inverse-surface`. |
| `secondary` | #adcdc8 | #4a635f | Operator/person glyphs and secondary accents (10.9:1 dark, 6.2:1 light on `surface`). |
| `secondary-container` | #2e4c48 | #cce8e3 | Operator message bubble and quiet selected fills. |
| `tertiary` | #c9ffeb | #00513f | Data and connector glyphs, 'Ready' tone (16.7:1 dark, 8.9:1 light on `surface`). |
| `tertiary-container` | #4cf0c7 | #5bfcd2 | Tertiary badge fill. |
| `error` | #ffb4ab | #ba1a1a | The only non-green hue: error text, destructive icon hover, threshold rules (10.9:1 dark, 6.2:1 light on `surface`). |
| `error-container` | #93000a | #ffdad6 | Danger button and degraded badge fill. |
| `primary-fixed` | #49ffb6 | #49ffb6 | Fixed primary tone, same in both themes. |
| `primary-fixed-dim` | #00e29b | #00e29b | Dimmed fixed primary; hover glyph on neon. |
| `secondary-fixed` | #c8e9e4 | #c8e9e4 | Fixed secondary; inline code ink on dark. |
| `secondary-fixed-dim` | #adcdc8 | #adcdc8 | Dimmed fixed secondary. |
| `tertiary-fixed` | #5bfcd2 | #5bfcd2 | Fixed tertiary. |
| `tertiary-fixed-dim` | #32dfb7 | #32dfb7 | Metric-capsule glyphs and the warning status dot (10.9:1 on dark `surface`; 1.6:1 on light — pair it with a word there). |
| `edge-hairline` | rgba(95,255,213,.12) | rgba(0,108,72,.16) | The default 1px chromatic border of cards and shells. Borders are never grey. |
| `edge-hairline-strong` | rgba(95,255,213,.25) | rgba(0,108,72,.32) | Stronger hairline: secondary buttons, flyouts. |
| `edge-focus` | #00f5a9 | #006c48 | Focus border: 1px, paired with the `focus-ring` glow. Never a browser outline. |
| `field-fill` | rgba(2,34,31,.4) | #ffffff | Input field fill. |
| `field-ink` | #fffbf5 | #171d1b | Text typed into inputs and the prompt console. |
| `field-placeholder` | rgba(255,251,245,.4) | rgba(63,73,69,.55) | Placeholder text in fields. Source value; low contrast by design — never put instructions in a placeholder. |
| `badge-tertiary-ink` | #c8e9e4 | #00382b | Ink for tertiary-tone badges. |
| `status-ok` | #00f5a9 | #00f5a9 | Healthy/live status dot. A dot on light grounds is 1.4:1 — always pair it with its status word. |
| `status-warn` | #32dfb7 | #32dfb7 | Queued/warning status dot; always with its status word. |
| `status-error` | #ffb4ab | #ba1a1a | Error/anomaly status dot and text. |
| `layer-1-bg` | rgba(2,34,31,.65) | rgba(255,255,255,.72) | Glass layer 1 fill (module shells, sidebar, top bar) with 16px backdrop blur. |
| `layer-2-bg` | rgba(6,26,24,.85) | rgba(255,255,255,.88) | Glass layer 2 fill (flyouts, prompt console, modals) with 24px backdrop blur. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display-lg);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-core);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 56px / 64px | 700 | `core` | Hero numbers and page-level statements. |
| `display-lg-mobile` | `.display-lg-mobile`, `--text-display-lg-mobile` | 36px / 44px | 700 | `core` | `display-lg` below 600px. |
| `display-sm` | `.display-sm`, `--text-display-sm` | 40px / 48px | 600 | `core` | Section openers on dashboards. |
| `display-sm-mobile` | `.display-sm-mobile`, `--text-display-sm-mobile` | 28px / 36px | 600 | `core` | `display-sm` below 600px. |
| `headline-lg` | `.headline-lg`, `--text-headline-lg` | 32px / 40px | 600 | `core` | Screen titles. |
| `headline-lg-mobile` | `.headline-lg-mobile`, `--text-headline-lg-mobile` | 24px / 32px | 600 | `core` | `headline-lg` below 600px. |
| `headline-md` | `.headline-md`, `--text-headline-md` | 24px / 32px | 500 | `core` | Panel titles. |
| `headline-sm` | `.headline-sm`, `--text-headline-sm` | 20px / 28px | 500 | `core` | Card group titles, the agent name in the agent bar. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `core` | Lead paragraphs of agent output. |
| `body-md` | `.body-md`, `--text-body-md` | 15px / 24px | 400 | `core` | Default body and streamed agent text. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `core` | Card subtitles, metadata, captions. |
| `label-lg` | `.label-lg`, `--text-label-lg` | 14px / 18px | 600 | `core` | Buttons, card titles, nav labels. |
| `label-md` | `.label-md`, `--text-label-md` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `core` | Chips, badges, small controls. |
| `label-sm` | `.label-sm`, `--text-label-sm` | 10px / 14px | 600 | `core` | Section and metric headers — always set UPPERCASE. |
| `mono` | `.mono`, `--text-mono` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Identifiers, scripts, filenames and keyboard hints only. |

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `core` | `--font-core` | `"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace` |
| `icon` | `--font-icon` | `"Material Symbols Outlined"` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-xs);
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-xs` | 0.25rem | 4px — icon-to-label gaps, tight stacks. |
| `space-sm` | 0.5rem | 8px — chip padding, row gaps. |
| `space-md` | 1rem | 16px — card padding, rail padding. |
| `space-lg` | 1.5rem | 24px — section gaps inside a panel. |
| `space-xl` | 2.5rem | 40px — gaps between major regions. |
| `gutter` | 1.25rem | Desktop grid gutter (12 columns). |
| `gutter-mobile` | 0.75rem | Mobile grid gutter (4 columns). |
| `margin` | 2rem | Minimum desktop page margin. |
| `margin-mobile` | 1rem | Mobile page margin. |
| `container-reading` | 840px | Max width of the conversation/reading column. |
| `container-dashboard` | 1440px | Max width of dashboard layouts. |
| `rail-width` | 288px | Docked primary sidebar rail. |
| `inspector-width` | 320px | Docked context inspector on the right. |
| `topbar-height` | 64px | Top bar height. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 0.1rem | 4px — inline code tags, small square badges. |
| `radius-default` | 0.25rem | 8px — the raised icon tile in card headers. |
| `radius-md` | 0.75rem | 12px — scale step equal to `radius-control`. |
| `radius-lg` | 1rem | 16px — scale step equal to `radius-card`. |
| `radius-xl` | 1.5rem | 24px — scale step equal to `radius-panel`. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Fully round: status dots, avatars. |
| `radius-control` | 0.75rem | Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, nav rows. |
| `radius-card` | 1rem | Cards and message bubbles (the user bubble squares its top-right corner to 0). |
| `radius-panel` | 1.5rem | Panels and the prompt console. |
| `radius-pill` | 9999px | Badges, chips and status pills — deliberately pill-shaped so they never read as containers. |

## Shadow

Depth is luminous glass, not shadow: layer shadows pair with `layer-*-bg` fills and chromatic hairlines.

### Use

```css
/* var(--layer-1-shadow) */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layer-1-shadow` | 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.4) · light: 0 4px 20px -6px rgba(6,40,33,.14) | Layer 1: module shells and cards. |
| `layer-2-shadow` | 0 12px 32px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 16px 0 rgba(0,245,169,.08) · light: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(6,40,33,.18), 0 0 16px 0 rgba(0,245,169,.10) | Layer 2: flyouts, prompt console, modals — adds a faint neon glow. |
| `layer-3-shadow` | 0 0 24px -2px rgba(0,245,169,.22), 0 20px 40px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.8) · light: 0 0 24px -4px rgba(0,245,169,.28), 0 20px 40px -12px rgba(6,40,33,.22) | Layer 3: the active command hub only. |
| `shadow-hairline` | 0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04) | Barely-there separation for the sidebar rail. |
| `glow-sm` | 0 0 14px rgba(0,245,169,.3) · light: 0 0 14px rgba(0,245,169,.45) | Resting glow of the primary button. |
| `glow-md` | 0 0 20px rgba(0,245,169,.5) · light: 0 0 20px rgba(0,245,169,.6) | Hover glow of the primary button — the accent gets brighter, never darker. |
| `glow-dot` | 0 0 8px #00f5a9 | Halo on live status dots. |
| `focus-ring` | 0 0 12px rgba(0,245,169,.2) | Focus glow, paired with a 1px `edge-focus` border. |

## Blur

Backdrop-filter radii for the glass layers.

### Use

```css
/* var(--blur-layer-1) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blur-layer-1` | 16px | Backdrop blur of glass layer 1 — only on surfaces that overlay scrolling content. |
| `blur-layer-2` | 24px | Backdrop blur of glass layer 2. |

## Grid

Column counts per breakpoint.

### Use

```css
/* var(--grid-columns-desktop) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grid-columns-desktop` | 12 | Desktop columns (20px gutters, 32px min margins). |
| `grid-columns-tablet` | 8 | Tablet columns; the rail condenses. |
| `grid-columns-mobile` | 4 | Mobile columns; side panels become sheets. |
